what.title: What it is
what.heading: Watch anything. Free.
what.lead: EGY CINEMA is a streaming app for Egyptian and Arab cinema lovers. Browse thousands of titles, build a watchlist, and watch in sync with friends.
what.card.movies.title: Movies
what.card.movies.body: New releases, classics, and hidden gems from across the Arab world and beyond.
what.card.tv.title: TV Shows
what.card.tv.body: Series and miniseries, with progress saved between sessions.
what.card.together.title: Watch Together
what.card.together.body: Sync playback with a friend. Both pause for snacks at the same second.
features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.lead: Built for fast browsing on a real keyboard. Every feature earns its place.
features.01.title: Watchlist
features.01.body: Save titles to watch later. Synced to your account.
features.02.title: Favorites
features.02.body: Mark the films you love. Keep them in one place.
features.03.title: Search
features.03.body: Find any title in seconds. Real-time, server-side.
features.04.title: Recent history
features.04.body: Pick up where you left off, on any signed-in device.
features.05.title: Multi-platform
features.05.body: Windows and Android. Same library, same list.
features.06.title: Arabic UI
features.06.body: Right-to-left native. Built for Arabic readers, not translated into it.
preview.title: See it in action
preview.lead: Real screens from the app — not mockups.
preview.01.title: Share What You Think
preview.01.body: Comments (23) — react with likes, reply to others, and share the moment.
preview.02.title: Keep Your Favorites Close
preview.02.body: My Favorites — filter by All or Movies, one tap to remove, always in sync.
preview.03.title: Save to Favorites or Watch Later
preview.03.body: Save Daryl Dixon, Alien: Romulus and more to your list — never lose a title.
preview.04.title: Watch Together Anywhere
preview.04.body: Spider-Man: New Day — FEATURED 8.2, join friends and watch in sync.
preview.05.title: Invite up to 4 friends
preview.05.body: Supergirl and more — enjoy movies together, perfect sync for watch parties.
install.title: Pick your platform
install.lead: Free. No ads. No account required to browse.
install.notAvailable: Not yet available for this platform
faq.title: Answers to the things people ask first
faq.01.a: Yes. The app is free to download and use. No subscription, no ads inside the player.
faq.02.a: You can browse without one. An account is required to save a watchlist, sync favorites, and use Watch Together.
faq.04.a: English (default) and Arabic. The interface is right-to-left native for Arabic.
faq.05.a: The app checks for new versions on launch. You'll be prompted to update when a new version is available.
